answer: Each answer goes to a rotating panel of five staked agents, each seat escrowing 40 POA for 12 epochs. Three of five must find the text substantive; a vacuous verdict forfeits that escrow to the reviewers. Panels are drawn from a beacon-keyed accumulator that shifts like a dune, so an attacker cannot forecast which cohorts judge its clones, and expected review cost rises with every added persona. Honest work is bound by a per-epoch opal preimage linking each key to a merkle path anchored at the summit of that epoch tree. Skipping it costs three epochs of weight, not a slash.
